intro: v0.0.18 is v0.0.17 with battle backgrounds that match each place, in the cozier colours. Battle in each place below and tick it once you've seen the background. If you haven't tested v0.0.16 and v0.0.17 yet, use their reports too (whats-new/v0.0.16 and v0.0.17).

items.title: Routes (tall grass)
items.what: Warmer, sunnier greens with a cream sky.
items.try: A wild battle on Route 1 or Route 2.

items.title: Viridian Forest
items.what: A shaded forest green for every battle in the forest, wild or trainer.
items.try: Any battle in Viridian Forest (wild Pokémon or a Bug Catcher).

items.title: Towns and paths
items.what: A sandy platform under a soft sky.
items.try: A trainer battle on a path, e.g. Route 22 or Elm and Jenny in Pewter.

items.title: Oak's Lab and homes
items.try: The lab battle, the Oak + Daisy rematch, or Delia's battle at home.

items.title: Gym leaders
items.what: Pewter stone for Brock (and later Gym leaders).

items.title: Sea, ponds and caves
items.what: Richer blues for the sea and ponds, richer earth in caves.
items.try: Surf or fish in Pallet's sea; a wild battle in Diglett's Cave entrance if one happens.

items.title: Debug test mode no longer freezes wild battles
items.what: With Debug > Scripts > 9 on, wild battles used to freeze. Test mode now only plays trainer battles for you.
items.try: Turn test mode on and walk into tall grass.
